p003-hba1c-series.text:
The user wants to know their HbA1c results and overall trend. I have three data points:

- 2024-04-10: 6.6%
- 2025-04-05: 6.1%
- 2026-03-31: 6.1%

So the trend is decreasing from 6.6% to 6.1%, and stayed at 6.1% in the latest reading. Let me present this clearly.

I should note that these are the only three readings available. The values are in mmol/L? No, HbA1c is a percentage. Let me present the trend.

The user asked in Chinese, so I'll respond in Chinese.
|你的糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）记录了三次检查结果：

| 检查日期 | 糖化血红蛋白 |
|---------|------------|
| 2024-04-10 | 6.6% |
| 2025-04-05 | 6.1% |
| 2026-03-31 | 6.1% |

**总体变化**：糖化血红蛋白从 6.6% 降至 6.1%，降幅 0.5%，目前稳定在 6.1%。趋势是向好的，但次数较少（仅 3 次），建议结合其他指标和临床医生评估综合判断。
